title: locales variables
description: Configuration variables for POSIX and glibc system locale generation

LOCALES_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install locales. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

LOCALES_VERSION.description: Specific version of locales to install.

LOCALES_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading locales binary or archive artifacts.

LOCALES_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying locales available remote releases.

LOCALES_DEFAULT.description: Default LANG system locale staged into /etc/locale.conf when provisioning a target sysroot.

LOCALES_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of locale entries staged into /etc/locale.gen when provisioning a target sysroot.
